name: net-name
assumes: two candidate drivers on one net; the one that wins names it (better(a, b) in connectivity.ts)
power_or_global: a power symbol or a global label (priority power, local power or global)
hier_bus: a bus member's name from a bus that reaches other sheets (a hierarchical label, a sheet pin or a global bus label on its group)
sheet_bus: a bus member's name from a bus that stays on its sheet
label: a local or hierarchical label, or a sheet pin, on the member's own wires
a and b never tie on everything: names differ when nothing else does
